description:
List item metadata (no body, token-light).

Two content families are distinguished by category prefix:
  - news articles: category="news" (or narrower, e.g. "news/world")
  - CVE/vulnerability advisories: category="security" (or "security/library" / "security/os" / "security/app")
Omit category to list both together.

Args:
    category: category prefix match. e.g. "news" matches all news/*, "security" matches all CVE, "news/world" narrows it
    status: filter by ingested/processed/enriched/published (all if omitted)
    source: feed identifier. e.g. "ghost-chinng-lab"
    lang: original language. e.g. "ja"
    since: lower bound on published_at (ISO 8601. e.g. "2026-07-01")
    until: upper bound on published_at (ISO 8601)
    q: title substring search
    limit: number of results (default 20, max 100)
    offset: paging start position

Returns:
    {total, count, limit, offset, items[]} — each item includes summary/summary_en/tags/
    entities/related_auto/license_note plus summary_omitted_reason, redistribution,
    keywords_en, entities_en, topics_en and numeric_facts, but **never the body**.
name: portal_list
